stories.title: Suspect charged in fatal e-bike crash
stories.summary: Gavin Schmid has been charged with two counts of felony aggravated driving while reckless following a fatal crash that killed one teen, and injured a second.

stories.title: Friday Night Football: Idaho high school state championship live scores
stories.summary: As the Idaho high school football season culminates, unexpected matchups in state championships beckon, with multiple southern Idaho schools poised to seize glory.

stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: Bogus Basin set to open for 85th winter season after 27 inches of snow
stories.summary: Bogus Basin is preparing to open for the 2026-27 ski season this weekend after receiving 27 inches of snow in 72 hours, with limited terrain and several lifts.

stories.title: Pay raise for Idaho lawmakers delayed until December 2027 amid stagnant state employee wages
stories.summary: Idaho lawmakers' salary increase is delayed, but their service allowance will rise, sparking debate about fair compensation for both legislators and state employees

stories.title: Former Nampa minister indicted on child sex abuse charges
